category_edits.rationale: Blend each GRU state with its causal recency-weighted prefix: 80% current state and 20% pooled states, with a five-step half-life. Applies to all four category models during training and inference; the predictor writer already imports this model class from train.py.

change_summary: Implement the specified causal 80/20 recurrent-state readout without changing the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, or routing.
